title: OpenAI Daybreak
summary: OpenAI Daybreak is a specialized cybersecurity platform that employs AI agents to autonomously detect and remediate software vulnerabilities. It functions as a managed security control surface built on a multi-tier deployment of the GPT-5.5 architecture.
research_notes: The initiative uses a tiered access model to manage dual-use risks, with the 'Cyber' variant reserved for verified red-teaming and advanced binary reverse engineering.

evolution.summary: Launched in May 2026, the project is transitioning from simple vulnerability scanning to autonomous patching through its Codex Security agentic harness. It is currently in a controlled rollout phase with key industry partners like Cloudflare and Cisco.
